answer: Miscellaneous >> Dua (Supplications) Question ID: 2867 Country: United Kingdom Title: I have a daughter aged 7 who doesn't walk or talk she has poor coordination and balance, she can crawl and looks perfectly normal, her medical diagnosis is microchephaly, small under developed brain can you tell me which wazeefa to pray to try and help her overcome her difficulties? Question: I have a daughter aged 7 who doesn't walk or talk she has poor coordination and balance, she can crawl and looks perfectly normal, her medical diagnosis is microchephaly, small under developed brain can you tell me which wazeefa to pray to try and help her overcome her difficulties? Answer ID: 2867 Posted on: Aug 30, 2020 Bismillah hir-Rahman nir-Rahim ! (Fatwa: 161/D-18/K) (1) Recite 'ya salaam' ( یا سلام ) 143 times with durood 11 times before and after, and then blow on the girl. (2) Also, recite 'Surah Fatiha' 11 times with durood before and after and then blow on water and preserve it in bottle. Get her drink the water throughout the day. Do this everyday, in-sha-Allah you will notice improvement. Allah (Subhana Wa Ta'ala) knows Best Darul Ifta, Darul Uloom Deoband, India
